subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the expanded Android audio/document attachment surface after its delivery, lifecycle, and proof requirements are completed?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Android capability with a protected maintainer label; patch correctness alone cannot establish whether this supported attachment matrix is the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded attachment surface
options.body: Keep the curated MIME matrix, require repair of the six findings and Android runtime proof, then review the refreshed merge result.

options.title: Narrow the supported matrix
options.body: Accept only the attachment kinds that Android history rendering and gateway staging can fully support, leaving other types for a later owner-backed change.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer this new Android capability until a maintainer confirms its intended support and UX contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded attachment surface
recommendation.body: Keep the curated MIME matrix, require repair of the six findings and Android runtime proof, then review the refreshed merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature’s branch history identifies steipete as the closest available routing candidate for the Android attachment design and follow-up evidence.
